name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_check_and_apply_upgrade
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::CheckAndApplyUpgrade reads the status-server edit text into the WOL connect context and returns the provider's upgrade-ready result for that context.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43e520 validates a 0x58-byte WestwoodOnlineUpgradeConnectContext, CWnd::GetWindowTextA on m_statusServerEdit with max count 9 into m_requestText at offset 0x24, and a return through the WOL provider vtable slot at offset 0x60 with the context base.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_check_and_apply_upgrade_smoke patches CWnd::GetWindowTextA and verifies request text, max count, m_statusServerEdit receiver, context base versus request-text offset, one provider call, and returned provider result.
